questions.question: What will be the output of the following?
questions.codeSnippet:
docker run --rm alpine echo "Hello"
docker run --rm alpine echo "World"
questions.explanation: Two separate containers are run, each executing echo and then exiting. Output is printed to the terminal.

questions.question: Given this Dockerfile, what happens when you run `docker build -t test .` and then `docker run test`?
questions.explanation: ENTRYPOINT sets the main command, CMD provides default arguments. The final command becomes `echo Bye Hi`.

questions.question: What does the following command sequence output?
questions.codeSnippet:
docker run -d --name test alpine sleep 10
docker exec test ls /
docker stop test && docker rm test
questions.correctOutput:
bin
dev
etc
home
... (standard Alpine root directories)
questions.explanation: `docker exec test ls /` runs inside the still‑running container and prints the root directory listing.

questions.question: Predict the output of this command after building the given Dockerfile.
questions.codeSnippet:
FROM alpine
WORKDIR /app
RUN echo "test" > file.txt
COPY file.txt /tmp
CMD ["cat", "/tmp/file.txt"]
questions.explanation: The file `file.txt` is created in `/app`, then copied to `/tmp`. The container’s CMD prints its content.

questions.question: What is printed when you run this multi‑stage image?
questions.codeSnippet:
FROM alpine AS stage1
RUN echo "secret" > /data.txt
FROM alpine
COPY --from=stage1 /data.txt /data.txt
CMD ["cat", "/data.txt"]
questions.explanation: The file created in the first stage is copied to the second stage and then printed.

questions.question: What does this `docker images` command display after the following sequence?
questions.codeSnippet:
docker pull alpine:3.18
docker tag alpine:3.18 myalpine:1.0
docker rmi alpine:3.18
docker images myalpine
questions.correctOutput:
REPOSITORY   TAG       IMAGE ID       CREATED        SIZE
myalpine     1.0       <image id>    ...            7.33MB
questions.explanation: After tagging and removing the original tag, the image still exists under the new tag.

questions.question: What will `docker ps -a` show after running the following?
questions.codeSnippet:
docker run --name temp alpine echo done
docker ps -a --filter name=temp
questions.correctOutput:
CONTAINER ID   IMAGE     COMMAND        CREATED         STATUS                     PORTS     NAMES
<id>           alpine    "echo done"    ...            Exited (0) ...                       temp
questions.explanation: The container runs and immediately exits. `docker ps -a` shows all containers, including stopped ones.
